evidence: Before removal, the metadata contained two relationships. After calling remove_column(table_name='table2', column_name='fk_1'), metadata.relationships became empty, and the repro script raised an AssertionError because the table1 -> table3 relationship should have remained.
steps: Loaded the 3-table metadata from the bug report.
Removed the foreign key column table2.fk_1.
Observed that both relationships were deleted instead of only the table2 relationship.
